articles.title: India, 32 other nations vote against UN resolution proposing death penalty pause
articles.description: India voted against the resolution along with 32 other nations, including Bahrain, China, Egypt, Iran, Iraq, Japan, Kuwait, the Maldives, Oman, Pakistan, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the United States.
